principles: Hook with a concrete decision failure, not labels or proprietary theory.
Define jargon immediately; avoid unexplained acronym stacks.
Outcome first; backwards AND derivation with one complete example.
Separate intent, hypothesis, inference, source witness, runtime, real-world observation, and permission.
Explain Git blob, tree, commit, HEAD and proof-of-bytes without calling them proof-of-truth.
Demonstrate both semantic scenario masks and actual copied-file mutation; keep denominator and oracle independent.
Explain a no-new-material-class tail and why sampled saturation does not prove universal completeness.
Bind diagrams to exact source revisions and negative or missing evidence.
Cover an authentic screenshot-to-finding case with the original-pixels availability limitation.
Explain browser/DOM, network/API, persistence, user and device as progressively stronger oracles.
Use at least three distinct public application examples with no shared runtime assumption.
Preserve the MS-10 11/92/70, 16/16 tie, 44 briefings and zero humans.
Offer a one-PR comparator pilot including reviewer time and rework, not an unmeasured ROI promise.
Show counterevidence, limits and what would falsify each important claim.
Keep the main prose readable without opening references; references are audit trail rather than prerequisites.
